description: Free. Shows the x402 price quote (XRP / RLUSD / USDC on the XRP Ledger, USDC on Base, USDC on Stellar) for any Lumi paid path, e.g. /v1/trust/check/high-value?url=...&amount=10, without paying. A 503 means the data is not fresh right now and the call would not be sold.
